prologue.title: The Night the Rune Cracked

prologue.briefing.speaker: bram
prologue.briefing.title: The Night the Rune Cracked
text: The equinox oath, as it has been sworn in this court for three hundred years: two elements, woven in the right order, hold the tide. One element is a spark. Two are a spell.
Try a pair. Fire and water will do. It will make steam, and I will pretend I meant it.
Do not stand in your own spells. That part is not tradition, only common sense.

prologue.ending.speaker: bram
prologue.ending.title: The Rune Cracks
text: That was meant to take an hour and a good lunch.
The Staff split in your hand. Did you hear it? A bell dropped down a well. The gates are open, and not only the four we know.
The sea gate is the only way out. Run.

bark.any: Breathe. The next one is already thinking about you.
Count your fingers, then your energy.
bark.ember_pyromancer: I would like it noted that most of that fire was on purpose.
The hat is fine. The hat has seen worse.
One day I will win a fight without smoke.
bark.rime_cryomancer: Quiet. Good. Count them, and then count them again.
The cold remembers where each of them stood.
bark.stone_druid: The pillar says you are welcome. I told it it was a pillar.
Rocks do not forgive. They do remember. Same thing, slower.
bark.storm_conduit: My hair has not been flat since the third wave. Do not look at it.
I can feel the next one in the rod. It hums like a kettle.
Anyone standing in water, please stop.
bark.arcane_archmage: He will charge on the third beat. I would not be standing there.
I have read this wave. The ending is untidy.
I know what comes next. I will not tell you. It spoils the casting.
bark.terra_geomancer: No, I do not need help. Yes, you may stand behind me.
My grandfather held this line with a shovel. I have better stones.
bark.zephyr_galesinger: The wind has stopped gossiping. That is how I know it is worried.
Do not say sorry to the trees. They are not in a forgiving mood.
Hear that? The gale is humming back.
bark.void_necromancer: You cast a new one. Good. I have not seen that one.
They are not mine. They never were. They are unfinished.
Hold on a little longer. I am holding on too.
